concerns.text: FR-007 (Text-Weight Alignment) and SC-005 (Linearity/Reconstruction Error) lack a complete task chain. T022c (generate ground truth) and T022d (reconstruction error) are marked as unchecked/missing. Without T022c generating `pairs.yaml` and `composite_ground_truth.npz`, T030 (linearity check) has no input data, leaving FR-007 and SC-005 untestable.

SC-004 (Sensitivity Analysis) is untestable. T022e (generate eval tasks) is unchecked/missing. The sensitivity sweep (T031) depends on `eval_tasks.yaml` generated by T022e. Without this task, the system cannot execute the required k={1,3,5,10} sweep.

FR-001 (Skill Vector Database) is incomplete. T014b (Execute vector_db.py to construct index) is unchecked. The spec requires a generated `skill_index.npz` for all downstream retrieval tasks (US2, US3). Without T014b, the foundational data artifact does not exist.

SC-001 (Baseline Comparison) is at high risk of failure. T026a-1 (download baseline adapters) is unchecked and explicitly states it must 'FAIL LOUDLY' if real baselines are missing. If this task is not implemented and executed, the primary success metric (degradation vs baseline) cannot be calculated.

FR-006 (Benjamini-Hochberg Correction) is partially unimplemented. T029b (apply BH to sensitivity sweeps) depends on T031 (sensitivity analysis). Since T031 relies on the missing T022e, the full scope of FR-006 (covering both primary comparisons AND sensitivity sweeps) cannot be satisfied.

FR-004 (Evaluation) and FR-008 (Multiple Runs) are blocked. T026 (runner.py implementation) and T027 (N>=5 runs loop) are unchecked. The evaluation pipeline cannot execute without these tasks, preventing the generation of success rates required for FR-005 and SC-001.

SC-003 (Latency Reporting) is partially unverified. While T019 logs latency, T038 (quickstart validation) is unchecked. The plan requires executing the pipeline to validate the full flow; without T038, the end-to-end latency measurement and validation of the 'quickstart' path is missing.
